semiconductor_relevance: High — HANCHI Technology provides automation equipment and software solutions specifically designed for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Shenzhen Hanchi Technology Co., LTD is a leading provider of automation equipment and software solutions for the semiconductor industry, focusing on intelligent manufacturing. The company specializes in automated packing lines and material handling systems, aiming to enhance efficiency and yield in semiconductor back-end processes.
capabilities: Auto Packing Line solutions for Reel and Tray packaging
Automated Material Handling Systems (AMHS) including OHT and WIP Stockers
Process inline control systems for semiconductor manufacturing
Comprehensive MES and EAP software systems

regional_presence.China: HANCHI Technology is based in Shenzhen, China, and serves the global semiconductor market.
